title: DORK v2.2 Renderer Performance Hardening
author: DEVADAAD
summary: Performance patch for ui/dork.html DORK renderer. No constitutional changes. No new invariants.

changes.description: 32 inline regex literals hoisted to module-level RX constants. Eliminates ~1920 regex compilations/sec during 60fps streaming.
esc() HTML escape rewritten from 3-pass chained .replace() to single-pass lookup table. One string allocation per call.
buildMsgEl() factory extracted. loadSession() now uses DocumentFragment for batch DOM append — one reflow per session restore.
Lazy D config refs. openCfg/saveCfg DOM queries consolidated. Config event listeners reduced to one delegated handler.
Stale == 9.75.0 version assertion updated to semver >= (9,75,0). Forward-compatible for all future versions.
Agent state drift corrected: phase 141→144, invariant_count 231→241, last_completed_phase garbled→clean Phase 144 string.

proposed_invariant.text: renderMd() shall contain zero inline regex literals. All pattern constants must reside in the module-level RX object, compiled once at load time.

track_b.required_action: GPG-sign annotated tag v9.77.1 on ADAADell
track_b.tag_command: git tag -s v9.77.1 -m 'patch: DORK v2.2 renderer perf hardening · 241 invariants · 50 innovations'
